{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsor beam''' was a focused energy beam created by a [[repulsor beam generator]]. When focused through a [[repulsor beam projector]], the resultant [[repulsorfield shell]] was used by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] to prevent collisions between their colony [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] and [[Realspace/Legends|space]] debris. When two repulsorfield shells came into contact, they ricocheted harmless away from each other.<ref name="SFS">''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]''</ref>
